class.description: Persistent graded terrain (slope) cost layer. Writes graded cost for gentle terrain and LETHAL for steep terrain / curb drop-offs, and accumulates over the rolling window so it persists as the robot moves.
Upstream nav2 ObstacleLayer plus an optional debug publisher that republishes the marking observations it consumes as a merged cloud on /observation_pcd. Enable with pub_lidar_observation: true.
